Securing and retaining skilled and creative event professionals can be challenging.
While established locally, expanding into new markets may pose challenges due to unfamiliarity with different regions.

sk.overview: The company is positioned in the modular exhibition stands industry serving the Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Exhibitions (MICE) sector in India. Modular exhibition stands are flexible and reusable display structures used by businesses to showcase their brands, products and services at trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, expos and promotional events. Unlike traditional custom-built stands that are typically designed for one-time use, modular stands are made from prefabricated components that can be assembled, dismantled and reconfigured multiple times based on event requirements. risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Relying on peak seasons for various services can lead to revenue fluctuations and operational pressure during off-peak periods.
- The event management industry is competitive, and sustaining market share requires consistent innovation and differentiation.
- Securing and retaining skilled and creative event professionals can be challenging.
- While established locally, expanding into new markets may pose challenges due to unfamiliarity with different regions.
- Expanding services or geographic reach may require overcoming logistical hurdles.
- Organizers need permissions from multiple concerned authorities, which becomes tedious when there are deadlines to be met.
- Reduced client budgets and decreased spending on events can negatively impact revenue.
- Event management companies work closely with food, beverage, hospitality and entertainment industries; volatility in any one of these industries could affect the event management service industry directly.
